description.value: Altmaerker is a family-owned German sausage house and deli in North Delta, operated by Stephan and Sandra Till, who immigrated from the Altmark region of Germany and opened the shop in 2012. Stephan is a certified Fleischer Meister who crafts housemade sausages and charcuterie entirely from traditional German and European recipes — all gluten-free, no binders or fillers. Touring cyclists will find a rich selection of housemade sausages, European-style breads and cheeses, pastries, condiments, custom sandwiches, and homemade soups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the website at altmaerker.ca, which confirms the business is a specialty German deli located in North Delta (11150 84th Ave Delta, BC V4C 2L7), contradicting the OSM community field of 'Richmond'. The website describes a wide range of European deli products — sausages, cheeses, breads, pastries, condiments — supporting basic groceries, and explicitly mentions homemade soups and bratwurst sandwiches supporting hot food. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Richmond' but the business is clearly located in North Delta (Delta, BC) per both the website and URL discovery notes — the OSM record may be geocoded or community-tagged incorrectly.
